recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, vertical rectangular portrait of a man in a top hat and tuxedo, styled like a vintage mechanical puppet or ventriloquist dummy with visible cut lines around the eyes and mouth. The image is set against a wide, off-white cream border with minimalist typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by a large negative space border
High-contrast dark clothing against a muted, grainy background
Mechanical 'cut-out' features contrasting with realistic skin textures
Geometric alignment of the central image within the square canvas
coreInvariants: Visible horizontal cut lines across the jaw and eyes
Grainy, low-fidelity halftone texture on the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertical rectangle occupying approximately 60% of the total width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face, specifically the stylized, drooping eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: starting at the text, moving to the top hat, then resting on the mechanical facial features.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white matte border surrounding the central image on three sides.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with high value contrast between the subject and the white shirt/border.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Double-line or inline effect on the primary title text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with weight or case variation for the subtitle.
graphicDevices: Faint fold lines or mechanical seams

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1970s geometric sans-serif aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1920s-style portrait of a man in a top hat and tuxedo with a white bow tie. Apply a heavy 1970s halftone print grain. Add visible horizontal cut lines across the eyes and jaw to suggest a mechanical dummy. Place this image as a vertical rectangle in the center of a large, aged cream-colored square background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered geometric sans-serif text at the very top. The first line should be in an inline/double-stroke style in muted pink. The second line should be lowercase in the same color, positioned directly below the first.

verificationChecks: Is the central image grainy and halftone-textured?
Are the mechanical 'cut' lines visible on the face?
Is the border color a warm off-white rather than pure white?
Is the typography centered and small relative to the canvas?

adjustableVariables: Color of the typography (within muted pastels)
mustRedesign: Specific facial identity of the man
Exact brand logos or specific band names
Unique hand-drawn imperfections in the original print
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the eyes look like cut-out paper inserts.
Check that the text does not touch the central image.
Verify the halftone dots are visible in the darker areas.
Confirm the overall composition is square.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central vintage halftone portrait + mechanical puppet cut-lines + wide cream border + top-centered geometric inline typography.
